name: LaunchMode
label: Launch Mode
description: Specify whether to launch a new browser instance or attach to an existing one.

selectOptions.label: Launch New Instance
selectOptions.description: Launch a new Microsoft Edge browser session.

selectOptions.label: Attach to Running Instance
selectOptions.description: Attach to an existing browser window.

name: AttachToInternetExplorerTab
label: Attach To Internet Explorer Tab
description: Specify how to attach to an existing Internet Explorer tab.

selectOptions.label: By Title
selectOptions.description: Attach to tab by its title.

selectOptions.label: By URL
selectOptions.description: Attach to tab by its URL.

selectOptions.label: Use Foreground Window
selectOptions.description: Attach to active tab in foreground window.

name: InitialUrl
label: Initial URL
description: Enter the URL of the website to visit when launching a new browser instance.

name: TabTitle
label: Tab Title
description: Enter the title (or part of it) of the IE tab to attach to.

name: TabUrl
label: Tab URL
description: Enter the URL (or part of it) of the IE tab to attach to.

name: WindowState
label: Window State
description: Specify whether to launch the browser window in normal, minimized, or maximized state.

name: TargetDesktop
label: Target Desktop
description: Set the connection string of the target desktop where the browser should launch.

name: ClearCache
label: Clear Cache
description: Specify whether to clear the entire cache of the web browser right after launching it.

name: ClearCookies
label: Clear Cookies
description: Specify whether to clear all stored cookies in the web browser right after launching it.

name: WaitForPageToLoad
label: Wait for Page to Load
description: Specify whether to wait for the initial page to load completely before proceeding.

name: TimeoutForWebpageToLoad
label: Timeout for Webpage to Load
description: Set the time in seconds for the page to load before the action fails.

name: IfAPopUpDialogAppears
label: If a Pop-Up Dialog Appears
description: Specify what to do if a pop-up dialog appears while loading the initial web page.

selectOptions.label: Close It
selectOptions.description: Automatically close any pop-up dialog that appears.

selectOptions.label: Press a Button
selectOptions.description: Press a specified button on the dialog.

selectOptions.label: Close It / Press a Button
selectOptions.description: Close or press a button on the dialog.

name: DialogButtonToPress
label: Dialog Button to Press
description: Enter the dialog button to press if a pop-up dialog appears.

name: TimeOut
label: Timeout
description: Set the time in seconds to wait for the browser to open before the action fails.

name: BrowserInstance
label: Browser Output
description: The new browser instance ID to use for automation actions.
